question.zh-CN: 怎样把单次任务效果转化为可测、可恢复、可持续运行的系统能力？
question.en: How is single-task performance turned into measurable, recoverable and sustained system capability?

research.zh-CN: 任务设计、泛化划分与统计显著性。
research.en: Task design, generalization splits and statistical significance.

industry.zh-CN: 现场任务映射、验收条件与回归集。
industry.en: Mapping to site tasks, acceptance conditions and regression suites.

compare.zh-CN: 成功率、覆盖、方差与失败分布。
compare.en: Success, coverage, variance and failure distribution.

problem.zh-CN: 发现连续运行中的累积故障。
problem.en: Expose failures accumulating during sustained operation.

research.zh-CN: 误差传播、鲁棒性与寿命建模。
research.en: Error propagation, robustness and lifetime modeling.

industry.zh-CN: 老化测试、任务中断与备件维护。
industry.en: Aging tests, interruptions and spare-part service.

compare.zh-CN: 运行时长、故障频率与恢复时间。
compare.en: Operating duration, failure frequency and recovery time.

problem.zh-CN: 限制危险动作和失控传播。
problem.en: Limit hazardous actions and failure propagation.

research.zh-CN: 安全控制、约束验证与风险感知。
research.en: Safe control, constraint verification and risk awareness.

industry.zh-CN: 保护链路、急停、隔离与责任边界。
industry.en: Protection chains, emergency stops, isolation and responsibility boundaries.

compare.zh-CN: 约束违反、响应时间与验证覆盖。
compare.en: Constraint violations, response time and validation coverage.

problem.zh-CN: 把模型稳定运行在目标设备上。
problem.en: Run models reliably on target devices.

research.zh-CN: 压缩、缓存、推理调度与在线适配。
research.en: Compression, caching, inference scheduling and online adaptation.

industry.zh-CN: 版本发布、灰度更新、回滚与兼容。
industry.en: Release management, staged updates, rollback and compatibility.

compare.zh-CN: 端到端时延、资源占用与回归结果。
compare.en: End-to-end latency, resource use and regression results.

problem.zh-CN: 在失败时维持可控运行。

research.zh-CN: 异常检测、恢复策略与人机协同。
research.en: Anomaly detection, recovery policies and human-robot cooperation.

industry.zh-CN: 报警、远程接管、故障定位与复位。
industry.en: Alerts, remote takeover, fault localization and resets.

compare.zh-CN: 介入次数、接管时延与恢复后完成率。
compare.en: Intervention count, takeover delay and completion after recovery.

problem.zh-CN: 管理多机任务与长期服务。
problem.en: Manage multi-robot tasks and ongoing service.

research.zh-CN: 协作调度、队列与资源优化。
research.en: Cooperative scheduling, queues and resource optimization.

industry.zh-CN: 工单、可用率、运维成本与设施对接。
industry.en: Work orders, availability, service cost and facility integration.

compare.zh-CN: 吞吐、利用率、每任务成本与停机。
compare.en: Throughput, utilization, cost per task and downtime.
